title: MerlinProgram
description: A dynamic, search-driven Merlin command. A Program is an Option whose `eventName` is 'super-daemon-run-program' and whose `value.program` is an async function `(input, values) => Promise<MerlinOption[]>`. When selected, Merlin switches into program mode: the program function is invoked with the current search text, and its returned array of Option-shaped rows replaces the top-level result list. The function is re-invoked (debounced ~150ms) on every keystroke. Programs are commonly lazy-loaded via dynamic import() of a createXProgram(context) factory module. Because JSON Schema cannot type a JavaScript function, the `program` and `initialValue` fields are documented here as descriptive strings; the README is authoritative for their callable signatures.

title.description: Display label of the Program's entry row in the top-level list (the row that, when selected, launches program mode).

eventName.description: Must be the literal 'super-daemon-run-program' for a Program.

icon.description: Icon name for the entry row.

image.description: Image URL for the entry row.

tags.description: Searchable tags for the entry row.

path.description: Breadcrumb path for the entry row (e.g. 'CMS/export/site').

priority.description: Sort weight of the entry row in the top-level list.

context.description: Visibility scope for the entry row, same semantics as MerlinOption.context.

voice.description: Voice-command phrase pattern that launches the program (e.g. 'export site').

more.description: Extra detail for the entry row (lit-html TemplateResult at runtime).

value.description: Program payload. Required keys: name and program. Optional: machineName, context, placeholder, initialValue.

name.description: Human-readable name shown as the program-mode title while the program is active.

program.description: CALLABLE — not a string at runtime. Async function with signature `async (input: string, values: object) => Promise<MerlinOption[]>`. `input` is the current search text; `values` is the bag passed into runProgram(). Each returned item is an Option-shaped row rendered by super-daemon-row. JSON Schema cannot express a function type, so this is documented as a descriptive placeholder string.

machineName.description: Stable identifier enabling runProgram('like', context, values, 'machineName') to resolve and invoke this program by name without holding a direct function reference.

context.description: Command context to activate when the program launches (e.g. 'CMS' or '>').

placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the search input while the program is active (e.g. 'Enter new title').

initialValue.description: CALLABLE — not a string at runtime. Optional async function with signature `async (values: object) => Promise<string>` whose non-empty string return pre-fills the search input when the program is launched generically (e.g. with no explicit like/search). Used by EditTagsProgram to pre-fill the active page's current tags.

index.description: AUTO-BUILT by defineOption() — do not set manually.
